acceptance_predicates.description: A fresh user can build, install, update a selected channel, test it, inspect status, and remove it through the native asb easy command family without cargo, Make, Just, Python, or shell prerequisites.

Explicit channel selection is validated against the existing channel manifest and active-channel contracts; omitted update selection preserves the active channel and unavailable channels fail before mutation.
Mutating operations provide human-readable guidance plus bounded --yes, --dry-run, and --json behavior without exposing credentials or private host paths.
The guided test path performs bounded local/mock lifecycle checks and does not contact a provider unless a separate explicit live operation is requested.
The easy build operation produces a bounded reproducible artifact for the selected profile, reports its path and digest, and never publishes or promotes a channel implicitly.
Interrupted updates and rollback expose actionable typed diagnostics and preserve the existing atomic install and recovery guarantees.

definition_of_done: Signed+DCO implementation is independently reviewed and merged on protected ASB main.
Focused positive/negative CLI, schema, completion, and lifecycle tests pass.
Exact current-main build/install/update/test/status/remove and rollback qualification passes with required hosted checks.

inputs.description: The existing asb easy guided workflow and human/JSON output contracts.
Existing asb tui channel install, upgrade, status, doctor, and removal contracts.

outputs.description: A dependency-free, user-friendly ASB channel lifecycle interface with tested recovery and documentation.

gates.description: Easy build/lifecycle command, channel, JSON, dry-run, confirmation, and negative tests pass.
Fresh-user build/install, selected-channel update, provider-free test, rollback, and removal pass.
Exact reviewed head and post-merge required workflows pass.
